'''Ram Kishore Saxena ''' [[Doctor of Science|D.Sc]], [[National Academy of Sciences, India|FNASc]] (born 11 November 1936) is an Indian mathematician and Emeritus professor, UGC [[Jai Narain Vyas University]] and former Professor and Head, Department of Mathematics.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae 1. Name : Saxena Ram Kshore 2. Date of - [PDF Document] |url=https://documents.pub/document/curriculum-vitae-1-name-saxena-ram-kishore-2-date-of-.html |access-date=2022-09-16 |website=documents.pub |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Ram Saxena - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=131134 |access-date=2022-09-16 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://worldcat.org/identities/lccn-nb2009031953/|title=Saxena, Ram Kishore [WorldCat Identities]}}</ref><ref name="auto">{{Cite web |title=MR: Saxena, Ram Kishore - 193316 |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/193316 |access-date=2022-09-16 |website=mathscinet.ams.org}}</ref>

== Published work ==
Saxena has published 356 research papers;<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Ram-Kishore-Saxena-2104384382|title=Ram Kishore Saxena}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/2108664018_Ram_Kishore_Saxena|title=Ram Kishore Saxena}}</ref> under his supervision many scholars has done PhD and post-doctoral research.<ref name="auto1"/> Saxena has published books.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Mathai |first1=A.
